sentences.text: Company, who were present today before this Lok Adalat through virtual mode, it is agreed that the awarded compensation amount of Rs.10,11,700/- be reduced to Rs.8,10,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs Ten Thousand only), which shall be payable to the claimants along with interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim application.
The said amount of Rs.8,10,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs Ten Thousand only) shall be deposited before the learned Tribunal within two months hence.

On such deposit being made, the said amount shall be disbursed to the claimants proportionately by modifying the amount of fixed deposit, in the terms as directed by the learned Tribunal in the impugned Award.

6. The statutory amount deposited in the Registry of this Court along with the accrued interest thereon shall be refunded to the appellant-Insurance Company, on filing of receipt showing deposit of the modified/settled compensation amount and interest before the Tribunal.
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.

opennyai_summary.facts:
This case is taken up in the 2nd National High Court Level Lok Adalat.
2. The claimants-parents approached the 2nd Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Northern Division,
Sambalpur under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeking compensation of on account of death of their son in a road accident owing to rash and negligent driving of offending vehicle-car bearing registration No.OD-15A-3750 by way of an application which was registered as MAC Case No.128 of 2015 (Sambalpur).
3.
It was directed for deposit of Rs.6,00,000/-
(Rs.3,00,000 X 2) in shape of fixed deposit for five years in Nationalised bank preferably under the Motor Accident Claims Annuity Deposit Scheme.
The petitioners were granted option to withdraw balance Rs.4,11,700/- along with accrued interest in equal proportion.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Company, who were present today before this Lok Adalat through virtual mode, it is agreed that the awarded compensation amount of Rs.10,11,700/- be reduced to Rs.8,10,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs Ten Thousand only), which shall be payable to the claimants along with interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim application.
The said amount of Rs.8,10,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs Ten Thousand only) shall be deposited before the learned Tribunal within two months hence.
On such deposit being made, the said amount shall be disbursed to the claimants proportionately by modifying the amount of fixed deposit, in the terms as directed by the learned Tribunal in the impugned Award.
6. The statutory amount deposited in the Registry of this Court along with the accrued interest thereon shall be refunded to the appellant-Insurance Company, on filing of receipt showing deposit of the modified/settled compensation amount and interest before the Tribunal.
7. Accordingly, MACA is disposed of.
8. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
